Jack, saw Matroid hosted ScaledML 2026 and keeps pushing its no-code vision platform into manufacturing.

Momentum like that usually surfaces more in-market enterprise accounts than the team can cover by hand, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Matroid off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Jack, quick follow-up for Matroid.

Enterprise computer vision deals are long, and demand from events like ScaledML usually outpaces rep capacity. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Matroid needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Matroid's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
